gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 13 build already compiles the landed devres helper packet, so this lane can keep MMIO-facing reviewability tied to the same bounded replay path as the other helper anchors.
The existing make target keeps the helper-first devres survey packet runnable through the same repeatable checkpoint as the rest of the Phase 13 tranche.

The landed helper lab already mirrors the bounded __devm_ioremap() lifetime split, exact devm_iounmap() pointer matching, and pure planning posture the roadmap allows inside the shared helper tranche.
Dedicated devres tests keep the current helper-only packet honest around managed acquire cleanup, resource-backed planning, devm_of_iomap() size reporting, and WC memtype reservation shaping.
The slice note records the narrow helper-first boundary so this lane does not overstate itself as live devres, MMIO, or device-tree parity.
The survey note now makes the roadmap gap explicit by naming the landed MMIO-adjacent planners together with the live-state boundaries that still remain blocked.

The helper lab already carries the bounded __devm_ioremap_resource() planner for memory-backed resource checks, inclusive size calculation, pretty-name shaping, busy-region failures, and remap cleanup without claiming live reservations.

The landed devm_of_iomap() planner keeps translated-resource selection by index, optional size reporting, and downstream planner failure shaping reviewable before any live device-tree ownership is attempted.
The current devm_arch_io_reserve_memtype_wc() helper records WC release bookkeeping and failure shaping while keeping live arch memtype mutation outside the shipped packet.
A dedicated coherent-DMA replay now keeps the helper-only packet honest about its blocked DMA-backed mapping and scatterlist boundaries without widening into live devres or transport ownership.
The next honest same-lane step is one tiny devm_arch_phys_wc_add() token-style planner, limited to release-token bookkeeping and failure shaping before any live arch memtype side effects are claimed.

Live DMA-backed mappings remain blocked because the current Phase 13 devres packet is still helper-first and reviewable rather than a claim of real coherent DMA allocation, attachment, or unmap side effects.
Live scatterlist ownership remains blocked because the current packet does not claim sg list allocation, chaining, DMA mapping, or teardown behavior beyond explicit boundary evidence.
Live MMIO mappings remain blocked because the roadmap still wants Phase 13 devres work to stay helper-first and reviewable instead of claiming real region mutation or address-space effects.
Live device-tree walking remains blocked because the current devm_of_iomap() slice only models translated-resource selection by index and should not pretend to own OF lookup or node lifetime.
Live arch memtype state remains blocked because the current WC helpers stop at bookkeeping and error shaping rather than mutating the real arch memtype token or release path.
